title: Chevening Scholarships 2027/2028 (UK Master's)
caption:
🎓 Chevening Scholarships 2027/2028 (UK Master's)

Fully funds a one-year master's degree at any UK university, covering tuition, flights, and a monthly living stipend.

📅 Deadline: 6 October 2026
✅ Eligibility: Nigerian citizens with an undergraduate degree and at least 2,800 hours (roughly two years) of work experience

No fees. No gatekeeping. Full details + how to apply (link in bio):
